source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: The Outskirts were intentionally retained as a separate eighteen-location canonical extension outside the reconstructed 528-location audit layer. This fixture recovers those canonical places, the three source-map farm children, and a small set of source-explicit contained businesses without inventing public commerce for industrial, institutional, or community locations. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only.

entities.name: 107.3 Morro Rock Radio
entities.source_summary: Orbital Air-controlled radio station mixing music with workplace instructions and quota reminders for the Morro Rock workforce.

entities.name: Independent Farms
entities.source_summary: Small Outskirts farms, mostly participating in Biotechnica's TradFarm Initiative, where Biotechnica supplies inputs and acts as primary distributor of the agricultural output.

entities.name: Edgewood Farm
entities.source_summary: Harris-family dairy farm operating under difficult environmental conditions and protected by automated defenses; the source does not establish public sales.

entities.name: Ingalls Farm
entities.source_summary: Vegetable farm whose family secretly diverts part of its harvest to selected high-end Night City restaurants in violation of its Biotechnica contract.

entities.name: Poppy Farm
entities.source_summary: Jack Boles' guarded farm growing Biotechnica-modified opium poppies important to the corporation; the source does not establish public purchasing.

entities.name: Jackson Plains Regional Airport
entities.source_summary: Scannelli-Odujinrin regional airport serving lower-budget passenger and logistics traffic, administered by Sionnach Taylor and secured by Aldecaldo Peacekeepers; passenger hospitality is handled by the contained Calbraith Diner.

entities.name: Calbraith Diner
entities.source_summary: Classic airport bar and greasy-spoon diner serving passengers waiting for flights.

entities.name: Laguna Bend
entities.source_summary: Small reclaimer town on the Laguna Reservoir with ordinary community institutions and two source-explicit customer-facing businesses: Flo's Diner and an independent fuel station with attached bodega.

entities.name: Flo’s Diner
entities.source_summary: Laguna Bend's only restaurant, owned by Flo Castleberry and known for exceptionally well-prepared SCOP burgers.

entities.name: Laguna Bend Fuel Station
entities.source_summary: Source-explicit independent CHOOH2 station whose attached bodega supplies most of Laguna Bend's everyday necessities; the source gives no proper business name or fixed shelf list.

local_offerings.label: Everyday supplies from the attached bodega

entities.name: Municipal Landfill
entities.source_summary: Night City's municipal waste site jointly operated by Petrochem and SovOil subsidiaries, with vehicle storage and maintenance infrastructure rather than public retail.

entities.name: Night City Spaceport
entities.source_summary: Orbital Air spaceport under construction on Morro Rock, scheduled to open in roughly three years; it is not yet an operational public travel service in 2045.

entities.name: NorCal Marshal Station
entities.source_summary: Fortified NorCal Marshal base used primarily by Highway Patrol and Rangers; no customer-facing commerce is established.

entities.name: Militech Ballistics & Explosives Range
entities.source_summary: Live-fire and explosives training range used by Militech and rented at times by the Estero Bay Military COG, NCPD and other security organizations.

services.label: Institutional live-fire and explosives training range rental

entities.name: Night Corp Solar Station
entities.source_summary: Heavily secured Night Corp and PacCon Electric solar array supplying a substantial share of Night City's energy needs.

entities.name: Northern Oil Fields
entities.source_summary: Declining oil fields operated by Petrochem and SovOil crews under an uneasy settlement; the location is extraction infrastructure rather than a public purchasing point.

entities.name: Petrochem CHOOH2 Station
entities.source_summary: Small Petrochem CHOOH2 station beside Interstate 9 with an equally small Hundred Under Haven attached.

entities.name: Hundred Under Haven
entities.source_summary: Small Hundred Under Haven store attached to the Petrochem roadside fuel station; the source names the outlet but does not define its local shelf contents here.
entities.catalogue_note: The recovery layer preserves the named chain outlet without fabricating a store-specific assortment from this entry.

entities.name: Pol-Bud Cement Factory
entities.source_summary: Pol-Bud cement plant that became the largest cement supplier for rebuilding Night City; the source describes industrial production rather than public retail.

entities.name: Pol-Bud Miasto
entities.source_summary: Pol-Bud company town where housing and local facilities are company-owned; worker-facing commerce includes a bar, CHOOH2 station and bodega paid for in cash or company credit.

entities.name: Pol-Bud Miasto Employee Commerce
entities.source_summary: Source-explicit but individually unnamed employee facilities covering a bar, CHOOH2 station and bodega within the company town.
entities.pricing_note: Workers can pay cash or charge purchases to company credit accounts.

entities.name: Pol-Bud Mine
entities.source_summary: Large Pol-Bud limestone mine operating continuously as part of the company's construction-material supply chain; no public commerce is stated.

entities.name: Sheriff’s Station
entities.source_summary: Small San Luis Obispo County Sheriff's station and vehicle base; the source establishes law-enforcement infrastructure rather than commerce.

entities.name: SovOil CHOOH2 Station
entities.source_summary: Small SovOil CHOOH2 station beside the New Pacific Highway with an equally small Oasis store attached.

entities.name: Oasis (SovOil Station)
entities.source_summary: Small Oasis store attached to the SovOil roadside fuel station; this entry establishes the outlet but does not provide its local shelf contents.
entities.catalogue_note: The recovery layer preserves the source-named chain outlet without materializing a store-specific assortment from this entry alone.

entities.name: Sunshine Motel
entities.source_summary: Block-clan roadside motel offering secure overnight lodging for 20eb and a hall of vendits supplying food to travelers.

local_offerings.label: Food from the motel vendit hall

entities.name: Union Railroad Station
entities.source_summary: Major cargo-train transfer point operated by the Snake Nation Groundhog Gulpers and regularly checked by NorCal Marshals; the Deadwoods' bunkhouse and supply depot are internal gang support rather than public commerce.

services.label: Rail cargo transfer and station operations
